title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash sparse attention on sm_120 — the shared-memory retile, measured
note: V4's vendored sparse_attn_kernel asks for 141312 B of dynamic shared memory at the real attention shape (h=64, d=512, block=64) and sm_120 caps at 101376 — the launch is refused, and it is the ONLY one of the six vendored kernels that fails on consumer Blackwell. phase0/v4_sparse_attn_sm120.py lifts the head axis out of the thread block (grid (m, b, ceil(h/h_block))); every other line is DeepSeek's. All numbers below were measured on the box named in `box`, not modelled.

smem_model.note: o_shared aliases q_shared at offset 0 (confirmed in the generated CUDA); the 8 B/thread is tilelang's cross-warp reduction workspace. Exact against every launch-failure number the box printed.

tiling_sweep.shape: b=1, h=64, d=512, topk=640, n_kv=640; decode s=1 / prefill s=33; 50 and 20 reps

results.status: ok, shipped as the small-smem fallback
FAIL — tilelang: M must be divisible by 16 (MMA atom). h_block < 16 does not exist.
FAIL — tilelang: warp_col_tiles must be divisible by 8. block/(threads/32) >= 8 and a multiple of 8.

equivalence_vs_eager.reference: v4_kernels_cpu.sparse_attn (fp32, on device) — the same function the CPU backend runs

real_shape.case: decode s=1 topk=633 (not a multiple of block)

randomized.note: auto and forced-retile distributions are IDENTICAL to the last digit — the retile is numerically neutral. The residual is the kernel's bf16 round-trip of the probabilities through acc_s_cast, which the fp32 reference does not do.

cross_check_vs_vendored_kernel.note: Both kernels run in one process on the box, at shapes where the VENDORED tiling still fits 99 KiB. 30 cases each, mixed batch/seq/topk/mask patterns.
cross_check_vs_vendored_kernel.verdict: BITWISE identical to DeepSeek's own kernel whenever the retile does not change the warp partitioning (h <= h_block). Where it does chunk, 5 elements in 1.7M differ by at most one bf16 ulp — that is T.gemm's fp32 accumulation order under a different warp tiling, not the head split, which is exact by construction.

jit_smoke.script: v4_jit_smoke.py, one subprocess per kernel, 300 s deadline

before.sparse_attn: FAIL InternalError: Failed to set the allowed dynamic shared memory size to 141312

jit_smoke.note: tile-ai/tilelang#2328 (the indefinite JIT hang feared on RTX Pro 6000) does NOT occur on this stack. Every kernel compiles in ~1.2 s.

end_to_end_toy_gpu.setup: v4_ref_cpu.cpu_args() model, full-range Stage(head+tail+dspark) + DSparkTail, prefill 33 + 20 greedy decode steps with a forward_spec draft every step. Weights generated once on CPU and loaded into both runs, so the streams are comparable.
end_to_end_toy_gpu.finite: every payload, tap, logit, draft and confidence finite on both devices; no crash
end_to_end_toy_gpu.verdict: The engine's GPU path runs end to end. CPU-vs-GPU divergence is the documented fp32-stand-in-vs-bf16-kernel effect on a random-weight toy whose argmax is near-degenerate (v4_ref_cpu already records the same effect between the reference's OWN prefill and decode branches); the sharp test is retile-vs-vendored ON the GPU, which is token-identical.

ring_bringup_warnings: fast_hadamard_transform is NOT installable on this image: pip build fails with 'The detected CUDA version (13.2) mismatches the version that was used to compile PyTorch (12.8)', and there is no prebuilt wheel for torch 2.10/cu128 (404). model.py's rotate_activation needs it for every Indexer layer, and v4_kernels_cpu.install() deliberately does NOTHING on the tilelang backend — so a GPU ring node will die at the first compress_ratio==4 layer unless a cu12.8 toolkit is provisioned or the torch butterfly in v4_kernels_cpu is registered for it. The e2e above used the torch butterfly.
safetensors was not installed on the base image; v4_stage imports it at module scope.
h_block < 16 is impossible (MMA atom), so a device tighter than 99 KiB cannot be reached by shrinking the head chunk further — only by shrinking `block`, which costs ~20%.
threads=64 is legal and 2.2x slower than threads=256 at the same tile; do not tune threads down to buy shared memory.
